transit.hint: List of public transit lines. Adjust fares and headways, or create and delete lines.
transit.createHint: Set the mode, fare, headway and stops to create a new public transit line.
transit.noLines: There are no active transit lines.
transit.fareNote: * Fares affect residents' route choice. Fares that are too high reduce ridership and increase car ownership.
transit.stopsNote: Enter stop coordinates (X, Z). In-game these will eventually be placed by clicking the 3D map.
transit.createSuccess: Created a new public transit line.
transit.createdButSuspended: The line was created but is suspended because its underlying network cannot support a round trip.
transit.createdButSuspendedReturnBlocked: The line was created but is suspended because the return trip is blocked on the underlying track. A double track (an opposite-direction track) is required.
transit.roundTripNote: Lines run as a round trip. They need an underlay that is traversable both ways (a double track, or a bidirectional single track); on a single one-way track the line will be suspended.

pauseReason.returnLegBlocked: Suspended: the return trip is blocked on the underlying track. A double track (an opposite-direction track) is required.
pauseReason.routeDisconnected: Suspended: the underlying route between stops is severed.
pauseReason.noUnderlay: Suspended: the running network for this line type is not configured.
pauseReason.trainTooLong: Suspended: the train is longer than the platform. Reduce the cars per train, or extend the station (platform).

transit.modeBusDesc: A bus line with stops placed on streets. Easy to lay out without tracks, but affected by road congestion.
transit.modeMetroDesc: A metro line with stations on tracks. Offers high capacity, but requires laying tracks and building stations.
transit.placementNote: Stops are placed on the 3D map after the line is created. You can create a line with no stops.
transit.placeStopHint: On the 3D map, left-click on a path where this line type can place stops (stations, streets, etc.) to add a stop. Right-click to finalize or delete.
transit.needTwoStops: A line needs at least two stops.
